notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). SCHULMAN: he was CEO until September 2023 (the 2025 proxy's pay-versus-performance section says 'Mr. Schulman served as the PEO in 2023' before Mr. Chriss took over on September 27, 2023). He is not a director or named executive officer in the 2025 proxy and is not in its security ownership tables, so his status is no-reported-stake. HOLDERS: the proxy gives the 5% owners as of December 31, 2024, but bases them solely on Schedules 13G/A filed in January and February 2024, so they are stale. The holding dates come from those 13Gs: Vanguard, December 29, 2023 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1633917/000110465924021682/tv01668-paypalholdingsinc.htm); BlackRock, December 31, 2023 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1633917/000108636424004846/us70450y1038_012624.txt). DIVIDENDS: none; the cash-flow statement has no dividend line. BUYBACKS exclude $351m of tax withholdings on net share settlement of equity awards.

ecosystem.ratioNote: PayPal revenue includes other value added services (credit interest and fees, partnerships, interest on assets) that are not earned on payment volume, so revenue ÷ TPV is not a like-for-like share.
